_about: Classification of laboratory mismatches. 'checks': engine-path mismatches, keyed <ledger>|<scope>|<team>|<statistic>. 'historicalValidation': differences recorded in expected-authoritative/VALIDATION.json, keyed '<ledger>: <restart> → <score>'. Categories: confirmed-application-defect, reference-or-fixture-defect, approved-definition-change, harness-drift, unresolved. An entry never changes an expected value; it records why a difference exists, with evidence. Every entry requires human review.

review|E|probe E-091.evidence: Review Edit offers TWO_POINTER for a Ladies Football point from a penalty. A penalty is taken from 11 m, inside the 40m arc — a goal or a point, never 2 (LGFA Official Guide 2026 Rule 426).
review|E|probe E-091.status: open — approved for repair in Phase C

options|ladies_football|TWO_POINT|tile \.evidence: The Ladies Football 2PT family offers a Penalty source (pro-tagger-families.ts TWO_POINT tiles). Rule 426: never a two-point score.
options|ladies_football|TWO_POINT|tile \.status: open — approved for repair in Phase C

review|E|probe E-X01.evidence: Review Edit offers SIN_BIN for a Ladies Football yellow card. A first Yellow Card offence is itself the sin bin; there is no separate sin-bin sanction (Rule 327).
review|E|probe E-X01.status: open — approved for repair in Phase C

options|ladies_football|DISCIPLINE|tile.evidence: Ladies Football capture offers a separate Sin Bin tile (getDisciplineOptions). Rule 327: the first yellow is the sin bin — recording both double-records one incident.
options|ladies_football|DISCIPLINE|tile.status: open — approved for repair in Phase C

re:^discipline\\|ladies_football\\|secon.evidence: A second yellow does not dismiss the player (Rule 327: second yellow followed by a red card).

re:^discipline\\|ladies_football\\|histo.evidence: Half-time timing: a sin bin issued at 27:00 of a 30-minute first half stays active indefinitely after half-time (buildDisciplineStatusMap keeps any earlier-period sanction active). Playing time carries across the interval — it must end at 07:00 of the second half. The same function serves men's football (report only).
re:^discipline\\|ladies_football\\|histo.status: open — approved for repair in Phase C

Recorded as not entered; never replaced by another event.
re:^capture\\|F\\|(TWO_POINT|POINT|WIDE).status: open — approved for repair in Phase C

ledger-A: A-118 → A-X02.evidence: A-118: Lab A Away's own kickout, won clean (2H 1400 s). A-X02: Lab A Away penalty goal at 1403 s, nothing recorded in between. A-X02 is a scripted event (scripts/gen-fixtures.mjs, 'scripted extra events … penalties, marks, cards'); the generator gives scripted events truth origin OTHER without modelling possession. docs/KICKOUT-ORIGIN-DEFINITION.md credits 'every score in a possession that began with a kickout, including frees won during it'.
ledger-A: A-118 → A-X02.resolution: The ledger's kickout-origin credit follows the written definition; the simulator's ground-truth label for the scripted event is the defect. The current production engine agrees with the ledger (engine path: origin RESTART rows match in every scope). VALIDATION.json is left unchanged as historical record.

ledger-B: B-025 → B-026.evidence: B-025: Lab B Away's own kickout, won clean (1H 301 s). B-026 was captured as a Lab B Away blocked/saved shot with truth origin RESTART B-025, then Review-edited to a point (fixtures/match-B.json reviewOps). VALIDATION.json compares the post-edit ledger with the pre-edit simulator truth, in which no score existed.
ledger-B: B-025 → B-026.resolution: After the Review edit the score genuinely belongs to B-025's kickout possession; the validation's truth predates the edit. ledger-B-live (before Review edits) has no difference. The current production engine agrees with ledger-B. VALIDATION.json is left unchanged as historical record.

ledger-C: C-135 → C-X01.evidence: C-135: Lab C Home wins Lab C Away's puckout, clean (2H 1198 s). C-X01: Lab C Home penalty goal at 1222 s, nothing recorded in between (next event C-136, a Lab C Home wide whose truth origin is RESTART C-135). C-X01 is a scripted event with truth origin OTHER, as for A-X02.
ledger-C: C-135 → C-X01.resolution: Same cause and resolution as ledger-A: A-118 → A-X02. The current production engine agrees with the ledger. VALIDATION.json is left unchanged as historical record.

ledger-E: E-078 → E-079.evidence: E-079 was captured as a wide in the possession of Lab E Home's kickout E-078 (lost) and a Review edit made it a point. VALIDATION.json compares the post-edit ledger with pre-edit simulator truth (no score existed there before the edit) — the same pattern as ledger-B: B-025 → B-026.
ledger-E: E-078 → E-079.resolution: The credit follows the written kickout-origin definition. VALIDATION.json is left unchanged.
